background_definition: No original GT with IoU>=0.1 or intersection/min(region_area,GT_area)>=0.2; partial foreground is localization, not semantic background

description.both: both visible flames and visible smoke
description.light: artificial light, glare or reflection, without visible flames or smoke
description.background: other background with neither visible flames nor smoke
description.uncertain: insufficient visible evidence to identify the content

instruction: Inspect only the visible content inside the thin white rectangular outline. Ignore the outline itself. Choose the best description of that region. Smoke alone is not a visible flame. Answer with one JSON object containing choice, using exactly one of the option letters. Options:
score_interpretation: Relative next-token probabilities over six fixed options; not calibrated correctness probabilities. Light/background distinction has no independent original GT.
scope: diagnostic only; no training, relabeling, filtering or test tuning
